title: Reading texts
description: Built-in passages for reading practice. They appear under Built in, in file order; the first one opens by default.

id.description: Stable id starting with b-. The reader remembers the last text by id, so never change or reuse one that has shipped.

title.description: Name shown in the text picker. Credit the source for published passages.

body.description: The passage. A blank line (\n\n) starts a new paragraph. Only use texts that are free to share.
